records.title: QMS still has no version history: a revision overwrites the effective controlled document in place, and no version is ever superseded
records.evidenceAtHead: (1) Schema unchanged: `git diff 92ccdba1 HEAD -- migrations/20260511_qms_and_labeling.sql` is empty. One row per document: qms_documents at migrations/20260511_qms_and_labeling.sql:23-43, unique (organization_id, doc_number) at :44-46. A grep for `qms_document_versions` across server/ client/ shared/ migrations/ db/ scripts/ finds nothing. (2) REST revise is still an in-place UPDATE of the same row, at server/routes/mdx-qms.ts:650-698 (UPDATE at :669-683). It sets status='draft', bumps the version and clears approver_id/approved_at, and it is admissible FROM 'effective'. The only trace of the prior version is metadata.lastRevision {reason, from, at, by}. (3) The AnA copy behaves the same way: revise_qms_document at server/services/ana/AnaToolExecutor.ts:14298-14351 (UPDATE :14322-14332). This is the path the register's Revise button uses: client/src/concept2cure/quality/SopRegister.tsx:440-457 calls onAsk, and the tool is 'confirm' class. (4) superseded_by_id is never written, and 'superseded' is unreachable. The header of migrations/20261001_qms_document_signature_required.sql says: "'superseded' is not covered: nothing in server/ writes it." The tool register at server/services/ana/tool-authorization.register.json:6031 describes revise as: "the effective version is withdrawn in place (hand-on)". (5) The downstream effect can be read in code: training compliance (mdx-qms.ts:853) and the readiness block (:252) count only status='effective', so a revised SOP drops out of both. (6) Commits since the audit that touch these files (c6f2028b2, f1d2589ff, 5726976d0, cf950eeb9, 0f961354c) do not change revise or versioning. 5726976d0 adds a deferred DB guard so a revised document cannot return to effective without a new same-transaction signature; that is useful, but it does not preserve the prior version.
records.remaining: The whole finding is still open. There is no immutable version store, so the approved version cannot be retrieved after a revision opens. No version stays in force while its successor is drafted. Nothing ever moves a version to superseded, so superseded_by_id and the 'superseded' status remain dead. Readers infer 'in force' from qms_documents.status. Revise is also implemented twice (route and AnA tool), which breaks the zero-duplication rule.
records.severityRationale: QMS controlled documents is a launch-catalog app. The first revision of an approved SOP in the pilot takes the procedure out of force and leaves no retrievable record of the approved version and its dates in the register. That is a data-integrity defect in a GxP record (21 CFR 820.40 / ISO 13485 4.2.4, and Part 11 §11.10(c) ready retrieval), and an inspector would find it on the first revised SOP. The founder could downgrade this only by explicitly positioning QMS as not the system of record for the pilot (an open question in the audit).
records.humanTestingNote: Steps: approve an SOP, then use Revise (it goes through AnA and needs a confirmation). The row becomes Draft v2.0, the 'effective' count drops by one, and the SOP disappears from Training compliance. The UI has no history view and cannot show v1.0 or its approval. Workaround: none in the product. Before revising, testers should note the approved version and signature details. Log the 'no effective version during revision' behaviour as known, not as tester error.
records.instructions:
1. Work on concept2cure-v2 only: `git pull --ff-only`, merge and never rebase.
2. Write the failing test first. Add tests/db/qms-document-versions.dbtest.ts in the DB tier, following tests/db/qms-document-signature-required.dbtest.ts. Steps: create a document as author A; PATCH it to in_review; approve as B through approveQmsDocumentSigned; then POST /api/mdx/qms/documents/:id/revise. Assert:
   (a) the document still has an in-force version '1.0';
   (b) that version's content_digest equals the bound_payload_digest of the v1.0 electronic_signatures row;
   (c) GET /api/mdx/qms/documents/:id/versions lists v1.0 as in force and v2.0 as draft;
   (d) after v2.0 is approved, v1.0 has superseded_at and superseded_by_version_id set.
   Run it at 94b4f9238 and keep the red output.
3. Add the new migration migrations/20261014_qms_document_versions.sql. It is additive and replayable (CLAUDE.md Rule 1) and needs a dated header note.
   - Create public.qms_document_versions with these columns: id serial PK; organization_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES organizations(id); document_id integer NOT NULL REFERENCES qms_documents(id); version text NOT NULL; doc_number, title, doc_type and category (text); metadata jsonb NOT NULL; next_review_date date; artifact_id integer; artifact_version integer; artifact_content_sha256 text; content_digest text NOT NULL; binding_basis text NOT NULL; approval_signature_id integer NOT NULL REFERENCES electronic_signatures(id); approved_by integer REFERENCES users(id); approved_at timestamptz NOT NULL; effective_date date NOT NULL; superseded_at timestamptz; superseded_by_version_id integer REFERENCES qms_document_versions(id); retired_at timestamptz; retirement_signature_id integer; created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now().
   - Use CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS, add UNIQUE (organization_id, document_id, version), and add an index on (organization_id, document_id).
   - Add an append-only trigger using CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION, and create the trigger only when pg_trigger lacks it (the idiom in migrations/20260923b_artifact_approval_follows_status.sql). It refuses DELETE, and refuses any UPDATE that changes a column other than superseded_at, superseded_by_version_id, retired_at and retirement_signature_id, or that changes one of those after it is non-null.
   - Run `ALTER TABLE qms_documents ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS effective_version_id integer REFERENCES qms_document_versions(id)`.
   - Backfill with INSERT … SELECT ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING, one row per status='effective' document that has a standing qms-document-approval signature whose signature_manifest->>'version' equals d.version. Then set effective_version_id. For effective rows with no signature, RAISE NOTICE with a count and never fabricate a row.
   - Write no DROP of anything another file creates.
4. Register the file in C2C_MIGRATION_FILES in scripts/db/migration-set.mjs, immediately after 'migrations/20261012b_regulatory_programs_eu_device_classes.sql' (~line 3258) and before UUID_TENANT_ISOLATION_NONPUBLIC. The table is public with an INTEGER org key, so TENANT_ISOLATION_SWEEP policies it. Run `npm run ci:migration-set-order` and `npm run ci:migration-drop-safety`. Add the drizzle definition beside qmsDocuments in shared/schema.ts (~line 19668).
5. In server/services/qms/document-approval-signature.ts approveQmsDocumentSigned (:316-391), on the caller's transaction and after persistGovernedActionSignature:
   - INSERT the snapshot row from the FOR UPDATE `row`, with content_digest, binding_basis, approval_signature_id = signed.id and effective_date.
   - UPDATE the document's previous in-force snapshot (superseded_at IS NULL AND retired_at IS NULL AND id <> new id), setting superseded_at = now() and superseded_by_version_id = the new id.
   - Set qms_documents.effective_version_id to the new id.
   For a future effective date, follow the CAT2-19 rule: the prior version stays in force until that date.
6. In retireQmsDocumentSigned (:478-552), stamp retired_at and retirement_signature_id on the in-force snapshot.
7. Put revise in one shared service function, openQmsRevision(client, {orgId, userId, documentId, reason}), in server/services/qms/. Call it from mdx-qms.ts:650-698 and AnaToolExecutor.ts:14298-14351, and delete the duplicate SQL from both callers. It changes only the working copy. It must leave effective_version_id and the snapshot untouched and clear effective_date (see CAT2-19).
8. Readers:
   - GET /qms/documents (mdx-qms.ts:340-359) and GET /qms/documents/:id (:433-446) return an `effective_version` object by joining on effective_version_id.
   - Add GET /qms/documents/:id/versions, tenant-scoped and registered before '/qms/documents/:id'.
   - The compliance query (:830-860), the readiness documents block (:250-258), review-due (:414-431) and server/services/audit/compliance-reports/queries/controlled-documents.ts decide 'in force' from the snapshot (effective_version_id IS NOT NULL, not retired, effective_date <= CURRENT_DATE), not from qms_documents.status.
   - Correct the false comment at mdx-qms.ts:133-137 ("'superseded' only by the revise route").
9. Client:
   - In client/src/concept2cure/quality/hooks.ts, map effective_version.
   - In SopRegister.tsx, a row in revision reads "Effective v1.0 · Draft v2.0 in revision".
   - Add a native version-history drawer that reads /versions, not an onAsk prompt.
10. Go green, then prove the gate. Remove the supersede UPDATE and confirm that the dbtest fails, then restore it. Extend tests/validation/oq/qms/run.mjs with a version-history step. File the red and green output under docs/evidence/.
records.acceptance:
- The new tests/db/qms-document-versions.dbtest.ts fails at 94b4f9238 and passes after the change.
- After revise, GET /api/mdx/qms/documents/:id shows the working copy as draft 2.0 and effective_version.version='1.0'.
- GET …/versions returns the v1.0 snapshot. Its content_digest equals the bound_payload_digest of the v1.0 approval signature.
- Training compliance and readiness still count the document as in force while v2.0 is drafted.
- Approving v2.0 sets superseded_at and superseded_by_version_id on v1.0.
- As app_service, UPDATE of a content column or DELETE on a snapshot is refused by the trigger.
- grep finds a single revise implementation.
- Removing the supersede UPDATE makes the dbtest fail (mutation shown).
records.dependencies:
- Ship together with CAT2-19 (effective-date rules and digest v2) and CAT2-20 (artifact bytes in the snapshot). CAT2-21's version-bound compliance reads effective_version_id.
- Related: CAT2-23 (review routing).
- Founder decision on QMS positioning (system of record vs SOP-register-lite), which sets whether this stays P0.

records.title: Effective date still carries over from the prior version and can be supplied (including backdated) outside the signed digest
records.evidenceAtHead:
(1) Approval still keeps the stored date: server/services/qms/document-approval-signature.ts:272 reads `effective_date = COALESCE($4::date, effective_date, $6::date)`, and the docstring at :181 says "defaults to the stored effective_date, else today".
(2) Revise does not clear the date: the UPDATE at server/routes/mdx-qms.ts:669-683 and the one at AnaToolExecutor.ts:14322-14330 leave effective_date untouched.
(3) The client never sends a date: postQmsApproval in client/src/concept2cure/quality/qmsApproval.ts:29-38 posts only password, mfaToken, meaning and reason.
(4) The date can be set outside the signature:
- docCreate accepts effectiveDate (mdx-qms.ts:164).
- PATCH maps effectiveDate→effective_date (:455-460) on draft or in_review rows (:476-482).
- approveBody accepts any YYYY-MM-DD, past dates included, as an optional field (:526).
(5) The digest excludes the date (:128-146). The existing test pins that exclusion: server/services/qms/__tests__/document-approval-signature.test.ts:40-52.
(6) There is no pending-effective state: DOC_STATUS at mdx-qms.ts:132 is draft|in_review|effective|superseded|retired.
(7) A command I ran confirms it. A tsx probe (scratchpad reverify/cat2-digest-probe.ts) computed computeQmsDocumentContentDigest for one row with effective_date set to 2025-01-01, 2026-12-31 and null. Output: "same digest: true".
(8) The only change since the audit is to APPROVABLE_STATES (cf950eeb9, now only 'in_review'). The date logic is unchanged.
records.severityRationale: Every revised SOP would show the previous version's effective date, and the in-force date is not covered by the signature. This is wrong controlled-document metadata that an auditor will notice. It is not an isolation or legal exposure on day one, but it must be fixed before pilot users rely on effective dates.
records.humanTestingNote: After Revise, the Draft or In-review v2.0 row still shows v1.0's date in the Effective column. After v2.0 is approved, the Effective date stays at v1.0's date instead of the signing date. The Approve dialog has no effective-date field. Workaround: none. Testers can take the true approval time from the signature confirmation.
records.instructions:
1. Work on concept2cure-v2: `git pull --ff-only`, merge and never rebase.
2. Failing tests first:
   (a) In server/services/qms/__tests__/document-approval-signature.test.ts, replace the case at :40-52 with one asserting that the v2 digest changes when the effective date changes.
   (b) In server/routes/__tests__/qms-document-approval-signature.test.ts, approve with no effectiveDate → 400 ESIGNATURE_COMPONENT_MISSING with nothing written.
   (c) Same file: an effectiveDate before the DB's CURRENT_DATE → 422 QMS_EFFECTIVE_DATE_BACKDATED with nothing written.
   (d) Revise sets effective_date to NULL.
   (e) POST or PATCH carrying effectiveDate → 422.
   Run all of them at 94b4f9238 and keep the red output.
3. In server/routes/mdx-qms.ts:526, make effectiveDate required: drop `.optional()`.
4. In the approve route (:602-644), before verifyApprovalSigner writes anything, run `SELECT $1::date < CURRENT_DATE AS backdated` on pool. If backdated, return clientError 422 with code QMS_EFFECTIVE_DATE_BACKDATED and the message 'An effective date cannot be earlier than today. Nothing was signed.' Pass body.effectiveDate (now non-null) at :627.
5. In server/services/qms/document-approval-signature.ts:
   - Change :272 to `effective_date = $4::date` (no COALESCE).
   - Make ApproveQmsDocumentSignedParams.effectiveDate a `string` (:181-182) and fix its docstring.
   - Add a v2 digest recipe that includes `effectiveDate` (the signed parameter) and the artifact fields from CAT2-20.
   - Bump QMS_DOCUMENT_BINDING_BASIS to 'qms-document-version-content-sha256/v2'.
   - Keep the v1 function exported so signatures already stored (selected by electronic_signatures.binding_basis) still verify.
   - Update the binding note at :368-370 and tests/validation/lib/qms-digest.mjs to recompute both recipes.
   - Have computeQmsDocumentRetirementDigest use the stored effective_date under v2.
6. Remove the date from editable input:
   - Delete effectiveDate from docCreate (mdx-qms.ts:164), so docPatch loses it too.
   - Delete it from the PATCH COL map (:458).
   - Stop writing effective_date in the create INSERT (:368-380). Unknown keys must be refused (zod .strict()) so a client cannot keep sending it.
7. In revise, set `effective_date = NULL`. Do it once, in the shared openQmsRevision service from CAT2-18. If CAT2-18 has not landed, do it in both mdx-qms.ts:669-683 and AnaToolExecutor.ts:14322-14330.
8. Handle pending effective without a scheduler (so the 20261001 signature guard needs no change). A document approved with effective_date > CURRENT_DATE is 'approved, pending effective'. All 'in force' readers add `effective_date <= CURRENT_DATE`: compliance mdx-qms.ts:853, readiness :252, review-due :423, plus the CAT2-18 snapshot rule (the prior version stays in force until that date).
9. Client:
   - In SopRegister.tsx's approve EsignModal (:593-609), add a required date input (default today, min today).
   - postQmsApproval (qmsApproval.ts:29-38) takes effectiveDate and sends it for kind 'document'.
   - The register's Effective column (:411) shows '—' for draft and in_review rows, and 'from <date> (pending)' for future dates.
10. Go green. Show the gate failing: restore the COALESCE and confirm test (c) or (d) fails, then revert. File the red and green output under docs/evidence/.
records.acceptance:
- At 94b4f9238: approving without effectiveDate returns 200, a past date is accepted, revise keeps the old date, and the digest ignores the date. Each new test is red there.
- After the change: no date → 400, a past date → 422, and nothing is written in either case (no electronic_signatures row, no ledger row).
- Revise sets effective_date to NULL.
- Approving v2.0 with date D stores D.
- Recomputing the v2 digest from the stored row equals electronic_signatures.bound_payload_digest. Changing effective_date in the DB afterwards makes the recompute differ.
- With D in the future, the register shows pending and compliance does not count the document until D.
- POST or PATCH with effectiveDate → 422.
records.dependencies:
- CAT2-18 provides the shared revise service and the rule that the prior version stays in force until the new date.
- CAT2-20 shares the digest v2 bump; ship them in one recipe change so the binding basis changes once.
- Related: CAT2-23.

records.title: QMS approval signature still binds only the artifact pointer; the linked artifact's content is mutable after approval
records.evidenceAtHead:
(1) The digest at server/services/qms/document-approval-signature.ts:128-146 covers `artifactId: row.artifact_id`. It covers no artifact version and no content hash. The function is unchanged except for APPROVABLE_STATES (`git diff 92ccdba1 HEAD`). The approval never reads concept2cure_artifacts.
(2) The audit marked mutability as UNVERIFIED. It is now verified: the artifact's content is rewritten in place on several paths:
- server/services/ana/artifactVersionStore.ts:350-355 (`UPDATE concept2cure_artifacts SET version, content, content_hash`, with no status check);
- server/services/ana/submission-chat-apply-rewrite.ts:651-660;
- server/services/module3-convergence-service.ts:651-660.
(3) The pointer can be set and is not tenant-checked: docCreate and docPatch accept artifactId (mdx-qms.ts:166, :459). The create INSERT (:368-380) stores it with no tenant check and no FK. migrations/20260511_qms_and_labeling.sql:39 is a plain integer.
(4) The append-only trigger for concept2cure_artifact_versions is in db/migrations/20260318_ga_immutability_hardening.sql. A grep finds no applier referencing that file at HEAD, so whether it is installed in a deployed DB is unverified.
(5) A command I ran confirms the binding. A tsx probe (scratchpad reverify/cat2-digest-probe.ts) shows the digest is a pure function of the row: artifact bytes are not an input.
records.remaining:
- Bind the artifact version and the sha256 of its bytes into the signed digest.
- Serve or lock the bound version so that later edits do not change the controlled text.
- Validate artifact_id as same-tenant on create and PATCH.
- Make sure the artifact_versions append-only trigger is on an applier.
records.severityRationale: Once an artifact is linked, the controlled text of an approved SOP can change with no new signature, which breaks the Part 11 §11.70 binding. The UI has no way to link an artifact today (REST only, editor role), so exposure is limited. It must still be closed before pilot users keep SOP content in linked artifacts.
records.humanTestingNote: Testers cannot observe this. The Quality UI has no field to link an artifact and no view of the document body, so testers never reach the mutable-content case.
records.instructions:
1. Work on concept2cure-v2: `git pull --ff-only`, merge and never rebase.
2. Failing tests first:
   (a) In server/services/qms/__tests__/document-approval-signature.test.ts: two rows identical except for the bound artifact content sha256 must give different v2 digests.
   (b) A DB-tier test in tests/db/: approve a document with artifact_id set, write a new artifact version through artifactVersionStore, then assert that GET /api/mdx/qms/documents/:id reports artifact_drift=true and still serves the bound version's content.
   (c) Approving with an artifact_id from another organization, or a missing one, → 409 QMS_ARTIFACT_NOT_FOUND with nothing signed.
   All three must be red at 94b4f9238.
3. In approveQmsDocumentSigned (document-approval-signature.ts:316-327) and retireQmsDocumentSigned (:478-488), when row.artifact_id != null:
   - Read the head with `SELECT id, version, content FROM concept2cure_artifacts WHERE id=$1 AND organization_id=$2 FOR SHARE`. If no row, throw QmsApprovalRefusedError (new code 'ARTIFACT_NOT_FOUND', mapped to 409 in approvalRefusal at mdx-qms.ts:596-600).
   - Compute sha256 of the content in the server; do not trust the content_hash column.
   - Read the concept2cure_artifact_versions row (artifact_id, version) and refuse if its content hash differs.
4. Add artifactVersion and artifactContentSha256 to the v2 digest recipe. This is the same bump as CAT2-19: binding basis 'qms-document-version-content-sha256/v2', with v1 kept for verifying old signatures. Also:
   - record both in metadata.approval and extraManifest (:371);
   - record them in the CAT2-18 snapshot (artifact_version, artifact_content_sha256);
   - update the binding note (:368-370) and tests/validation/lib/qms-digest.mjs.
5. Serve the controlled text of an effective version only from concept2cure_artifact_versions at the bound version. GET /qms/documents/:id and /versions return artifact_drift when the head's sha256 differs from the bound sha256.
6. Validate artifact_id on POST /qms/documents (mdx-qms.ts:361-399) and PATCH (:448-510) with `SELECT 1 FROM concept2cure_artifacts WHERE id=$1 AND organization_id=$2`; otherwise return 422.
7. Put the concept2cure_artifact_versions append-only trigger on an applier. Write a new additive file that uses CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION and creates the trigger only if pg_trigger lacks it, insert it into C2C_MIGRATION_FILES in scripts/db/migration-set.mjs before UUID_TENANT_ISOLATION_NONPUBLIC, and prove it with a dbtest where UPDATE of a version row is refused.
8. Go green. Show the gate failing: drop artifactContentSha256 from the recipe and confirm test (a) fails, then revert. File the evidence under docs/evidence/.
records.acceptance:
- Tests (a), (b) and (c) are red at 94b4f9238 and green after the change.
- The stored electronic_signatures.bound_payload_digest recomputes from the snapshot plus the bound artifact version's bytes. Changing one byte of that version's content makes the recompute differ.
- A later AnA edit of the artifact leaves the effective version's served text unchanged and sets artifact_drift=true.
- A foreign or missing artifact_id: 422 on create or PATCH, 409 on approve, nothing written.
- UPDATE of a concept2cure_artifact_versions row as app_service is refused.
records.dependencies:
- CAT2-19: share the single digest v2 bump.
- CAT2-18: the snapshot table stores the bound artifact version.
- CAT2-26: no UI to link content yet, which limits exposure but does not fix this.

records.title: Read-and-understood training: the any-user /api/qms write is gone; acknowledgments are still version-blind, accepted on non-effective documents, unassigned, unsigned, and have no UI
records.evidenceAtHead:
Fixed:
- server/routes/qms.ts and server/services/qms/qms.service.ts no longer exist (ls: no such file). c6f2028b2 deleted them and removed the mount in server/bootstrap/register-document-routes.ts.
- At 92ccdba1, `git show 92ccdba1:server/routes/qms.ts` :106-121 took `b.userId` from the body and wrote no audit row. That path is closed.

Refuted at audit time (AnA ack_training):
- The handler is still at server/services/ana/AnaToolExecutor.ts:14369-14404, but it is unreachable.
- server/services/ana/tool-authorization.register.json:4-13 classes it 'refuse'.
- preHandlerRefusal returns NOT_AN_ANA_ACTION before any handler runs (AnaToolExecutor.ts:513-516). It is wired into every handler by registerToolHandler (:565-575).
- The same 'refuse' entry exists at 92ccdba1 (`git show 92ccdba1:server/services/ana/tool-authorization.register.json`), so a model could not create training evidence even then.

Still open:
(1) Compliance counts acknowledgments of any version. The acks CTE at server/routes/mdx-qms.ts:838-845 groups by document_id only, with no document_version filter. Revise keeps the same document_id, so v1.0 acks count toward v2.0.
(2) training-ack (:757-792) checks only tenant and existence (:766-770). It accepts draft, in_review and retired documents. It also takes a client-chosen `method`, including 'electronic_signature' with no ceremony, and a client `quizScore` (:771-772).
(3) The denominator is the whole org roster (:835-837). No assignment table exists.
(4) There is no client caller of /training-ack: grep in client/src finds only the compliance read in hooks.ts:127. The 'Record training' button (SopRegister.tsx:543-555) hands off to AnA, which refuses ack_training.
records.fixedBy: c6f2028b2. It deleted server/routes/qms.ts and server/services/qms/qms.service.ts and removed the /api/qms mount, pinned by server/routes/__tests__/qms-legacy-api-retired.test.ts. The AnA ack_training sub-point was already neutralised at 92ccdba1 by tool-authorization.register.json 'refuse' plus AnaToolExecutor.ts preHandlerRefusal :513-516.
records.remaining:
- Version-bound compliance (numerator tied to the in-force version).
- Refuse acknowledgments unless the document is effective and of a trainable type.
- Make the acknowledgment an e-signed act by the trainee, with the method fixed server-side and no client quiz score.
- Role or curriculum assignment as the denominator.
- A native acknowledgment UI.
- Delete the dead AnA ack_training handler and its tool definition.
records.humanTestingNote: Clicking 'Record training' in Quality opens AnA. AnA refuses (NOT_AN_ANA_ACTION) and tells the user to record it on the document's training record, but no such control exists, so a tester cannot complete the read-and-understood journey in the UI. Compliance bars show N of the whole org roster. After a revision is approved, v1.0 acknowledgments still count. Workaround for testing only: each tester sends POST /api/mdx/qms/documents/<id>/training-ack (body {}) from devtools against an approved document. Do not trust the resulting percentages.
records.instructions:
1. Work on concept2cure-v2: `git pull --ff-only`, merge and never rebase.
2. Failing tests first, in a new server/routes/__tests__/qms-training-ack.test.ts (pattern: qms-governed-writes-audited.test.ts):
   (a) ack on draft, in_review or retired → 409 QMS_NOT_TRAINABLE with nothing written;
   (b) ack without password → 400 ESIGNATURE_COMPONENT_MISSING;
   (c) a quizScore or method in the body is refused with 422 under zod .strict();
   (d) compliance: v1.0 acks exist, then revise and approve v2.0 → current = 0 for that document;
   (e) the denominator equals the assigned users, not organization_users.
   All must be red at 94b4f9238.
3. training-ack (mdx-qms.ts:757-792):
   - Read version, status and doc_type, and refuse unless the document is in force (status 'effective', or the CAT2-18 snapshot in force) and doc_type is in the trainable list (:854).
   - Make it a signed act by the trainee: parse {password, mfaToken?, meaning:'RESPONSIBILITY', reason?} and run reverifySigner. Do not run checkSigningAuthority, because any member signs their own training.
   - In one transaction, write the qms_training_records INSERT with acknowledgment_method fixed to 'electronic_signature' and quiz_score NULL, recordGovernedAction (command 'sign', target 'qms-document:<id>'), and persistGovernedActionSignature (signatureType 'qms-training-acknowledgment', binding = the in-force version's content digest).
   - Add a manifest statement that the signer has read and understood v<version>.
4. Compliance (:826-860): count `COUNT(DISTINCT t.user_id) FILTER (WHERE t.document_version = <in-force version> AND (t.expires_at IS NULL OR t.expires_at > NOW()))`.
